title: Studio hook form: the refusals help text says 'JavaScript (L2) bodies only', but a handler hook may declare refusals since #33641
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD

Filing gate: ③ nit N1 of the at-tier contract record 6893396284 on PR #33796 (#33657), also noted by its dev with no carrier. A nit on a schema-face file is not fixed in that PR, so it gets its own card.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`, the `refusals` row's `helpText`). Grade p3, self-graded by the seat. It is a wording fix that no runtime reads. Filed and parked: only p1/p2 are worked now (the maintainer's 「后续只处理 p1 p2」).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open hook form refusals helpText handler` finds nothing.

## 维护者速读

钩子表单里「拒绝目录」的说明文字还写着「仅限 JavaScript (L2) 代码体」。但 #33641 之后，handler 类钩子也能声明拒绝目录，表单本身也提供 handler 选项。所以这句话不准确了。只改说明文字，不改行为。

## Facts

- `hook.form.ts:59`: the `refusals` row help text ends "JavaScript (L2) bodies only".
- `hook.zod.ts:843-844` (since #33641): refusals are declared on "a js body or a handler".
- The form offers the legacy `handler` row (`hook.form.ts:83`).

## Ask

Reword the help text to match `HookSchema` (a JS body or a handler), with a key in every metadata-form bundle `check:i18n` asks for. Wording only; `Clause-②: no`.
